admission: source-bound correctness receipt, complete local base/optional checks and both hosted CI jobs passed on checked source before new postflop learning
checkpoint_storage: atomic own-v1 legal-weight gzip snapshots; hash/metadata/menu/bit checks; final compressed JSONL archive; stream one record, never decode 840 profiles together
own_replay: each fixed worker replays its own saved checkpoints without training before completing; same three partitions
native_stage: own published first for recorded study; comparison-only OpenSpiel2.0.2 Apache-2.0; all EV/exact+restricted roots/achieved own replies+river hybrids at1e-9; no native action or policy export

analysis.axes: work and iteration separately; never pool
analysis.primary: all four original primary metrics in chips and percent initial pot
analysis.contrasts: all 32 conditional one-factor differences plus all15 averaged nonempty factorial differences (order1..4; mean signed product times2^order); paired seeds/individual values retained; deterministic full controls reused, never independent seed replicates
analysis.bridge: four declared full-only averaging/initialization points; last endpoint aliases common cell, no repeated training
analysis.uncertainty: three fixed external seeds, individual values and arithmetic means; no seed-population confidence intervals, significance or best-arm/default admission

partial: retain every completed snapshot/event and failure reason; incomplete grid cannot become complete report or favorable subset
scope: original known-game causal-controls diagnosis only; no new representation/seed/budget/action/range, no best-arm selection/default/fresh/global admission
